svg.title: ESP32-S31 dual-module RGMII board, block diagram
svg.desc: Two ESP32-S31-WROOM-3 modules, RGMII MAC to MAC in both directions with a clock delay block per direction, USB-C power and USB-Serial-JTAG per module, UART and PPS headers. Design only, not built or measured.
svg.text: design only, not built or measured
Two ESP32-S31-WROOM-3 modules, GMAC to GMAC in RGMII, no PHY.
Each direction has its own clock, driven by the sender; the receiver gets it delayed (source-synchronous).
1000 Mbit/s at 125 MHz (APLL, as the driver does today); the 62.5 MHz bring-up (500 Mbit/s) is planned and needs a driver change.
+5V (common rail of both modules, fed through the two diodes)
Both modules running need both USB-C plugged,
or one source that advertises 1.5 A or more.
Each port is also the USB-Serial-JTAG console of its own module.
A to B data: TXD0-3, TX_CTL (5 lines)
22 ohm series at the driver: R301-R305
B to A data: TXD0-3, TX_CTL (5 lines)
22 ohm series at the driver: R311-R315
RGMII at 125 MHz wants the RX clock 1.0 to 2.6 ns after the data.
74LVC1G34 at 3.0 to 3.6 V: 0.5 / 2.0 / 4.1 ns (min / typ / max).
Bring-up at 62.5 MHz (500 Mbit/s, planned): about 4 ns +-2, one or two buffers.
Meander alternative: about 6.5 to 7 ps/mm on FR4, 250 to 300 mm for 1.5 to 2 ns.
